english: I was so hungry, I went to the dojo to ask my sister for something to eat...
But unfortunately, Sis was out.
No! Someone hit me in the back of the head!
...They came from behind, and I passed out right away... They looked like a ronin, maybe? Hmm...
No, I'm broke.
Oh! But they stole my Gin Tama! The ones I kept inside my clothes!
Why, Gin?
That's really annoying... And worse, he's got a point.
That sounds extremely plausible, actually.
When did we decide that?!
Huh? Well, I've only got a bump on my head... Wait, what are you planning?
Huh?!
G-Gin... You really care that much about me?!
Yes, understood.
Not much luck... Kabukicho's too big to search blindly.
Easy for you to say... Oh, that reminds me!
Sorry. Hijikata thinks a Joi rebel attacked me for my Gin Tama.
Kagura, I wasn't murdered.
Something...? Gin! That's Saburo!
Not a person! Mr. Hiraga's giant robot!
What's that...? A letter? Gin, it's from Mr. Hiraga!
What does it say?
What do you mean? He invited us, so let's go.
You two! Behave! Sorry... Thank you for inviting us.
What?! Those guys?!
I told you, I'm alive!!
Sorry I look weak! Well, too bad! I've got nothing worth stealing!
It's fine. Saburo's already beaten them up pretty badly.
They only stole a few Gin Tama to begin with.
Could you explain properly?
Of course. Almost everyone in Edo has some, don't they?
What do you mean, Mr. Hiraga?
Why ask Mr. Hiraga...?
Ah! I get it!
I'm not being a know-it-all! Everything inside Gin Tama is in Japanese, right?
Exactly! That's the point! Right, Mr. Hiraga?
But what's wrong? Suppose you did make the Gin Tama... What's the problem?
Then why...?
True... Even if each one is weak, gather enough of them and...
Oh... That's why Sis...!
Yes... He said he'd found Dragon Balls in that river...
A toy company, you said? What was its name?
Wait a moment, Gin!
Maybe Katsura also suspects something behind Gin Tama and is investigating in secret...
Exactly! An old pest you can't shake. But that's why...
What's wrong, Gin? You've gone awfully quiet.
Banbanji!
Hmm... Maybe all we can do is gather as many Gin Tama as possible and examine them.
Oh... Maybe Katsura was gathering Gin Tama to find out exactly how they work...
Say his name! You made me wonder who! It's Hedoro, the florist!
Those Gin Tama might actually be incredibly dangerous.
So could you hand over all your Gin Tama, Mr. Hedoro?
No, what I mean is...
W-wait a second...! ...He's gone.
A-a-a-a-a-ah...!
O-Otsu's over there!!
Stop it, Gin! She doesn't want to!
...Was that, by any chance, a Justaway...?
Is this really okay...?
I'm sorry. But this is for your own safety too, Otsu.
That's dangerous in a much more literal sense.
...Then that means...?
That's Otsu for you! Gin never stood a chance!
Obviously! I'm the founding captain of Otsu's fan club!
Of course I'm on Otsu's side!
Be a good loser! Hand over your Gin Tama!
Otsu's side, naturally.
Oh, sorry! I couldn't help it.
Huh? Otose isn't here.
What's happened? It's almost time to open the bar...
Gin! Let's hurry and see what's going on outside!
Moving's too much work...?
What's happened to her...?
Huh? Sis is at the gate... putting up some kind of sign?
Sis, what's that sign?
Wasn't restoring the dojo Father's... I mean, YOUR dream, Sis?!
Ah! That's not the sister I know!
Anyway, Sis! That sign's coming down! You're not selling the dojo!
Don't tell me Sis too...
Saigo's scary when he's full of energy too, but...
Maybe. He's just standing there, staring at the toilet...
Wow... What a lifeless reply!
Y-yes, that's right. Why?
Why not just go inside and get it over with?
K-Kagura, that's a bit much...
Pull yourself together!
Don't ask me! I don't know! ...Oh... Look!
There's Hedoro... What's wrong? He was in a hurry to look after his flowers...
Um... What about looking after your flowers?
What?! Even Hedoro's like that?!
That makes me mad all over again...
My head hurts...
With you two around, this headache will never go away!
Just forget it.
Awooooo!!
We're old pals. I'll get him to treat me to dango!
What is it, old man? Sending Saburo all the way to fetch us...
Ah, you're back too, Saburo! Good work!
Yeah, I've heard.
An Amanto? What do they want?
Suspicious...
That frog's the one pressuring the shogunate?
That bastard! Just wait till I see him again!
Right, let's go.
Let's split into two groups. We'll find him faster.
Do that. I'll feel better that way too.
I know.
Leave this area to Kondo's group. Otherwise, why split up?
You're the worthless ones, you monkeys!
Do your job properly!
Who knows... I haven't heard the details.
The shogunate has told us as much.
You think so too, Toshi?
We can't act if we don't know their objective.
Let's find Katsura.
Don't be reckless, Toshi.
Who's coming?
It's bound to be something stupid.
Then I'll go with Kondo.
Still, I don't like this...\fGin Tama may be fun, but used the wrong way, they're dangerous weapons.\fWhat happens if those things fall into the hands of the Joi rebels...?
The shogunate must know that too.\fHm? You're...
Nationwide? Really?
What's a niche celebrity doing here?
Katsura was here.
That cyborg from before?!
What's that nose-job lady doing?
Fine, just get going!
Where was he?
Skip the food tips. What did that suspicious guy look like?
All right. I'll look into it.
Found you, Michael! So this is where you were!
I told you I'm not a cyborg! I only had my nose done!
Michael! Why aren't you at the recording?!
Don't give me that! You took so long, I came looking for you!
Ouch! Just my luck!\fI came to the hospital with sore muscles and ran into the Shinsengumi!
Weird foreigner?! My shopping show made me famous nationwide!
No idea. Nothing to do with me.
Ouch! Just my luck! I ran into Marilyn!\fWe had a fight recently. I'd rather not see her.
Shit! Just my luck! I forgot all about the recording!
I'd better get back! They'll fire me from the show!
Oh, right. I saw someone really suspicious earlier.
A seriously scary guy. The type who'd kill without a second thought.
Don't overwork. Take it easy.
Anyway, the Shinsengumi are here.
An event?
Would you like some ramen too?
That's so true.
Looking for someone?
Yes?
Just eating ramen.
Flowers. I run a flower shop.
Roooaaar!!
Move your foot!!
A cockroach!
Well, if it isn't Otose and Catherine. Having a meal?
Gave out odd dolls with flowers.
Just as I'd heard.
Which one's the suspicious guy...?
...He certainly looks suspicious...
Looks like he'd kill without blinking...
What are you doing here?
Ramen?
A florist with that face? Even more suspicious!
You want a fight, bastard?!
W-what?! My foot...?
What? A cockroach...?
Is this vicious-looking Amanto really a florist?
Seriously?
Looks like it was a misunderstanding...
I'm on duty. No time to eat.
Tch... Another wasted trip.
Let's go and see...
No need to use the back exit...
Oh, it's Hedoro.
Catherine, you need to work harder.
Oh, you're from the Shinsengumi...
Yes, it's true. That's Hedoro, the florist near my place.
Why would I lie to an official?
That sounds lively enough.
Superb noodles here.
Gin! Finally!
Oh, you're not Gin.
I've no use for you.
A hit job?
A Joi leader. A dangerous man.
No idea. Not interested.
Suspicious, aren't you? I really don't know.\fBut...
Some radical Joi rebels are planning something.
I heard one of those radical groups was planning some spectacular fireworks.
A bomb.
A bomb shaped just like that.
Defuse it quickly, or it'll explode.
I was in the Oniwabanshu. I can defuse a bomb.\fSo... red or blue?
I prefer red, so I'll cut the red wire.
Oh. No red wire.
No blue wire either...
There! Snip! Bomb defused.
Looks like they posed as customers and left a Justaway here.
The flowers?
If it's flowers, why not visit a florist?
